review: I see no difficulty curve here. First Steps teaches gaps and spikes cleanly, then Spike Garden stops everyone: ghosts stand in front of a spike cluster for 45 seconds and only 2 of 100 finish. Crumble Bridge is the one tuned stage, with readable tiles and one saw, but it is easier than Saw Mill and Ferry Lines before it. Spring Loaded is inverted: the low-skill player finishes while better players stall beside the first spring. Laser Gate kills at two seconds with four beams and a faint telegraph. Gauntlet tests springs and lasers together that were never taught; 3 of 100 finish.
best: Crumble Bridge: a readable new mechanic, one saw as a twist, and an 80% pass rate with deaths that look like the player's fault.
worst: Spike Garden: stage 2 is a wall that no skill level gets past, so most players never see the remaining six stages.
